core.matched_upstream_description: v0.8.0-31-gd07f6b5 (2025-01-18); 18 core source/header files match; VERSION differs

quickjs.decision: Keep the current API fork; prioritize a separately reviewed core security backport or core upgrade. The next HarmonyOS pin is preview-only.

assessments.summary: Error stack: CallSite insertion OOM causes a heap use-after-free
assessments.evidence: CallSite insertion failure frees the transferred value twice and leaves transferred fields for cleanup.

assessments.summary: Promise: reject-function OOM causes a heap use-after-free
assessments.evidence: On reject-function allocation failure the resolve function is freed without clearing the caller output slot.

assessments.summary: RegExp: alternation OOM causes a heap out-of-bounds write
assessments.evidence: Reported lower bound is 0.15.1; the current 0.8-era RegExp compiler needs its own allocation-error review, rather than assuming the newer compiler report proves this snapshot is affected.

assessments.summary: JSON.stringify: rope indentation leaks a heap address
assessments.evidence: No rope string implementation is present in the matched older core; the reported rope indentation route does not map to this snapshot.

assessments.summary: BigInt memory leak in Atomics.store when SharedArrayBuffer is detached during operation
assessments.evidence: Detached-buffer error returns do not release the converted value.

assessments.summary: Integer overflow in TypedArray.prototype.sort leads to heap buffer overflow on 32-bit
assessments.evidence: The sort index allocation multiplies len by sizeof without checked size arithmetic; ARM32 is an application target.

assessments.summary: Heap buffer overflow in js_proxy_get_own_property_names via integer overflow on 32-bit
assessments.evidence: This older Proxy implementation uses sizeof(tab[0])*len in js_mallocz. The advisory extra_len variant is different; review the related 32-bit allocation overflow, without claiming its exact exploit was reproduced.

assessments.summary: Use-after-free in js_array_buffer_transfer on external ArrayBuffers
assessments.evidence: External-buffer transfer reallocates foreign backing stores. The current Dart bridge calls JS_NewArrayBufferCopy, so the external allocation route is not supplied by its documented buffer API.

Corrected 2026-11-07: this d07 core uses generic JS_SetPropertyInt64 in js_array_push and has no later optimized array_len/count path. Retain shrink/grow/push/GC regression without backporting the unrelated d98ff101 condition.

assessments.summary: quickjs RCE via js_array_toReversed() dense-array copy constructor
assessments.evidence: All four copy constructors publish count before initializing slots and before getter re-entry.
